summary: Spree Commerce is an open-source, API-driven e-commerce platform built on the Ruby on Rails framework. It provides a modular foundation for building online stores and managing product catalogues, customer orders, and storefront logic.
goodFor: It is well-suited for development teams with existing Ruby on Rails expertise who need a customisable, headless e-commerce backend.
watchOut: You will need to maintain a Ruby environment and handle custom frontend integration, as it is primarily a backend-focused system.
deployNotes: Deployments typically require a Ruby application server, a relational database, and a reverse proxy to handle incoming TLS traffic.
